rules.prepare:
if [ "$AELTRA_BUILD_FOR" = "cross-tools" ]; then EXTRA_OPTS="--build=$AELTRA_BUILD_TYPE --with-sysroot=/ --with-ld=/tools/bin/${AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE}-ld --with-as=/tools/bin/${AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE}-as" elif [ "$AELTRA_BUILD_FOR" = "tools" ]; then EXTRA_OPTS="--build=$AELTRA_BUILD_TYPE --with-sysroot=/tools --with-ld=/tools/bin/${AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE}-ld --with-as=/tools/bin/${AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE}-as --program-prefix=${AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE}-" else # spoof the build type to trigger a cross build EXTRA_OPTS="--build=`bh_spoof_target_triplet $AELTRA_BUILD_TYPE` --with-sysroot=/ --with-ld=/usr/bin/${AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE}-ld --with-as=/usr/bin/${AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE}-as" fi
cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR"
if [ "$AELTRA_BUILD_FOR" = "tools" ]; then # fix interp to be located in /tools/lib grep -rl '"[^"]*/lib\(32\|64\)\?/ld' gcc/config | while read filename; do sed -i -e 's@"/lib\(32\|64\)\?/ld@"/tools/lib/ld@g' \ -e 's@:/lib\(32\|64\)\?/ld@:/tools/lib/ld@g' \ -e 's@%(dynamic_linker_prefix)/lib\(32\|64\)\?/ld@/tools/lib/ld@g' "$filename" done else # fix interp to be located in /usr/lib grep -rl '"[^"]*/lib\(32\|64\)\?/ld' gcc/config | while read filename; do sed -i -e 's@"/lib\(32\|64\)\?/ld@"/usr/lib/ld@g' \ -e 's@:/lib\(32\|64\)\?/ld@:/usr/lib/ld@g' \ -e 's@%(dynamic_linker_prefix)/lib\(32\|64\)\?/ld@/usr/lib/ld@g' "$filename" done fi
# Run autoconf for some of the patches to take effect. GCC insists on # version 2.69. for SUBDIR in . gcc libcc1 libffi libgo libstdc++-v3; do cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/$SUBDIR" && AUTOM4TE=autom4te2.69 autoconf2.69 done
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR"
unset CFLAGS unset CPPFLAGS unset CXXFLAGS unset LDFLAGS
# GCC is built with its own flags, but without the path of the build in what # is installed. This is also why configure is called with a relative path. export CFLAGS="-g -O2 -ffile-prefix-map=$AELTRA_WORK_DIR=." export CXXFLAGS="$CFLAGS" export CFLAGS_FOR_TARGET="$CFLAGS" export CXXFLAGS_FOR_TARGET="$CFLAGS"
# As in Debian, GCC and its libraries have branch protection, like everything # that is built with the flags of the distribution. On x86_64 --enable-cet # does it. A flag like this for another architecture has to be added here and # in aeltra-pack. case "$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" in aarch64-*) CFLAGS="$CFLAGS -mbranch-protection=standard" CXXFLAGS="$CXXFLAGS -mbranch-protection=standard" ;; esac
case "$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE" in aarch64-*) CFLAGS_FOR_TARGET="$CFLAGS_FOR_TARGET -mbranch-protection=standard" CXXFLAGS_FOR_TARGET="$CXXFLAGS_FOR_TARGET -mbranch-protection=standard" ;; esac
../sources/configure \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --libexecdir="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib" \ --with-default-libstdcxx-abi=new \ --with-system-zlib \ --with-pkgversion="Aeltra OS" \ --disable-multilib \ --disable-multiarch \ --disable-nls \ --disable-vtable-verify \ --disable-bootstrap \ --disable-libquadmath \ --disable-libsanitizer \ --disable-libssp \ --enable-shared \ --enable-libstdcxx-time=yes \ --enable-linker-build-id \ --enable-threads=posix \ --enable-tls \ --enable-languages=c,c++ \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --target="$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE" \ `bh_gcc_config_for_machine $AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE` \ $EXTRA_OPTS
rules.build:
# HACK: to disable compilation of DFP support in libgcc case "$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE" in powerpc*) export libgcc_cv_dfp=no ;; esac
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make -j"$AELTRA_PARALLEL_JOBS"
rules.install:
GCC_VERSION="`cat $AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/gcc/BASE-VER`"
for ENTRY in all cpp-16 fixincludes g++-16 gcc-16 gcc-16-base libatomic1 libcc1-0 \ libgcc libgcc-dev libgomp1 libitm1 libstdc++6 libstdc++-16-dev \ gcc-16-plugin-dev; do install -d -m 0755 "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$ENTRY" done
FULL_INSTALL="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/all"
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make DESTDIR="$FULL_INSTALL" install
# we never use 'lib64', move everything to 'lib' if [ -d "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib64" ]; then mkdir -p "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/" mv "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib64/"* \ "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/" rmdir "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib64/" ln -sf lib "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib64" fi if [ -d "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE/lib64" ]; then mkdir -p "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE/lib" mv "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE/lib64/"* \ "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE/lib/" rmdir "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE/lib64/" ln -sf lib "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE/lib64" fi
if [ "$AELTRA_BUILD_FOR" = "cross-tools" ]; then PATH_OFFSET="$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE" else PATH_OFFSET="" fi
find "$FULL_INSTALL" -name "*.la" -exec rm '{}' \; rm -fr "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/share/doc" rm -fr "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/share/info" rm -fr "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/share/man"
# these are all provided through the corresponding tools-* packages if [ "$AELTRA_BUILD_FOR" = "cross-tools" ]; then rm -f "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/"lib*.so* fi
# The programs have names with the system type and the major version. Those # without the version are made by the maintainer scripts. The compiler of the # tools folder has no names without the system type, those belong to the cross # compiler. GCC_MAJOR="${GCC_VERSION%%.*}"
mv "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin" "$FULL_INSTALL/bin.orig" install -d -m 0755 "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin"
for PROG in cpp g++ gcc gcc-ar gcc-nm gcc-ranlib gcov gcov-dump gcov-tool lto-dump; do if [ -e "$FULL_INSTALL/bin.orig/${AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE}-${PROG}" ]; then BASENAME="${AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE}-${PROG}" else BASENAME="$PROG" fi
cp -a "$FULL_INSTALL/bin.orig/$BASENAME" \ "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/${AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE}-${PROG}-${GCC_MAJOR}"
if [ "$AELTRA_BUILD_FOR" != "tools" ]; then ln -s "${AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE}-${PROG}-${GCC_MAJOR}" \ "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/${PROG}-${GCC_MAJOR}" fi done
rm -r "$FULL_INSTALL/bin.orig"
if [ "$AELTRA_BUILD_FOR" = "cross-tools" -a -d "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE" ]; then find "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE" -type l -a -name "*.so" | while read LINK; do LINK_TARGET="$(basename `readlink $LINK`)" ln -sf "/usr/lib/$LINK_TARGET" "$LINK" done fi
# Nothing in the tools folder is called cc: it would be taken for the compiler # of the build by what is built for the tools. if [ "$AELTRA_BUILD_FOR" = "target" ]; then for PROG in c89 c99; do install -m 0755 "$AELTRA_WORK_DIR/extra/$PROG-gcc" \ "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/$PROG-gcc-$GCC_MAJOR" sed -i "s/^exec gcc /exec gcc-$GCC_MAJOR /" \ "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/$PROG-gcc-$GCC_MAJOR" done fi
# Needed by nothing: what libcc1 is loaded by is in the folder of GCC. rm -f "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/libcc1.so"
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------- PKG_PATH="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/cpp-16" # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
install -d -m 0755 "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin" install -d -m 0755 "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/gcc/$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE/$GCC_VERSION"
mv "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/"*"cpp-$GCC_MAJOR" \ "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin" mv "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/gcc/$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE/$GCC_VERSION/cc1" \ "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/gcc/$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE/$GCC_VERSION"
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------- PKG_PATH="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/fixincludes" # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
install -d -m 0755 "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin" install -d -m 0755 "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/gcc/$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE/$GCC_VERSION"
mv "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/gcc/$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE/$GCC_VERSION/install-tools" \ "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/gcc/$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE/$GCC_VERSION" install -m 0755 "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/fixincludes/fixinc.in" \ "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/gcc/$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE/$GCC_VERSION/install-tools/fixinc.sh"
echo \ "#! /bin/sh
PATH=\"$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/gcc/$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE/$GCC_VERSION/install-tools:\$PATH\" export TARGET_MACHINE=\"$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE\" exec fixinc.sh \"\$@\" " > "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/fixincludes" chmod 0755 "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/fixincludes"
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------- PKG_PATH="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/g++-16" # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
install -d -m 0755 "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin" install -d -m 0755 "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/gcc/$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE/$GCC_VERSION"
mv "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/"*"g++-$GCC_MAJOR" \ "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin" mv "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/gcc/$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE/$GCC_VERSION/cc1plus" \ "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/gcc/$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE/$GCC_VERSION" mv "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/gcc/$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE/$GCC_VERSION/g++-mapper-server" \ "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/gcc/$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE/$GCC_VERSION"
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------- PKG_PATH="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/gcc-16" # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
install -d -m 0755 "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin" install -d -m 0755 "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/gcc/$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE/$GCC_VERSION/plugin"
mv "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/"* \ "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin" mv "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/gcc/$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE/$GCC_VERSION/collect"* \ "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/gcc/$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE/$GCC_VERSION" mv "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/gcc/$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE/$GCC_VERSION/lto"* \ "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/gcc/$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE/$GCC_VERSION" mv "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/$PATH_OFFSET/lib/"*.spec \ "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/gcc/$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE/$GCC_VERSION" || true mv "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/gcc/$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE/$GCC_VERSION/liblto_plugin.so"* \ "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/gcc/$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE/$GCC_VERSION" mv "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/gcc/$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE/$GCC_VERSION/plugin/"libc[cp]1plugin.so* \ "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/gcc/$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE/$GCC_VERSION/plugin"
# ar, nm and ranlib of binutils load the LTO plugin from here. The link to it # is made by the maintainer scripts. install -d -m 0755 "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/bfd-plugins"
if [ "$AELTRA_BUILD_FOR" != "cross-tools" ]; then ln -s ../../../libcc1.so.0 \ "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/gcc/$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE/$GCC_VERSION/libcc1.so" fi
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------- PKG_PATH="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/gcc-16-base" # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
install -d -m 0755 "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/gcc/$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE/$GCC_VERSION"
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------- PKG_PATH="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/libatomic1" # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
install -d -m 0755 "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/$PATH_OFFSET/lib" mv "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/$PATH_OFFSET/lib/"libatomic*.so.* \ "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/$PATH_OFFSET/lib" || true
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------- PKG_PATH="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/libcc1-0" # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
install -d -m 0755 "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib" mv "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/"libcc*.so.* \ "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib" || true
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------- PKG_PATH="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/libgcc" # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
install -d -m 0755 "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/$PATH_OFFSET/lib" mv "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/$PATH_OFFSET/lib/"libgcc*.so.* \ "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/$PATH_OFFSET/lib" || true
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------- PKG_PATH="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/libgomp1" # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
install -d -m 0755 "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/$PATH_OFFSET/lib" mv "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/$PATH_OFFSET/lib/"libgomp*.so.* \ "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/$PATH_OFFSET/lib" || true
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------- PKG_PATH="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/libitm1" # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
install -d -m 0755 "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/$PATH_OFFSET/lib" mv "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/$PATH_OFFSET/lib/"libitm*.so.* \ "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/$PATH_OFFSET/lib" || true
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------- PKG_PATH="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/libstdc++-16-dev" # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
install -d -m 0755 "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/$PATH_OFFSET/include" install -d -m 0755 "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/$PATH_OFFSET/lib"
mv "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/$PATH_OFFSET/include/c++" \ "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/$PATH_OFFSET/include" mv "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/$PATH_OFFSET/lib/libstdc++"*.a \ "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/$PATH_OFFSET/lib" mv "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/$PATH_OFFSET/lib/libstdc++"*.so \ "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/$PATH_OFFSET/lib" mv "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/$PATH_OFFSET/lib/libstdc++.modules.json" \ "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/$PATH_OFFSET/lib" mv "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/$PATH_OFFSET/lib/libsupc++"*.a \ "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/$PATH_OFFSET/lib"
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------- PKG_PATH="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/gcc-16-plugin-dev" # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
install -d -m 0755 "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/gcc/$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE/$GCC_VERSION" mv "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/gcc/$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE/$GCC_VERSION/plugin" \ "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/gcc/$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE/$GCC_VERSION" || true
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------- PKG_PATH="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/libstdc++6" # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# gdb only loads the script with the pretty printers from here. For the target # of a cross compiler it is in the package of the target. GDB_DIR="$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/share/gdb/auto-load/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib"
if [ "$AELTRA_BUILD_FOR" = "cross-tools" ]; then rm -f "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/$PATH_OFFSET/lib/libstdc++.so".*-gdb.py rm -fr "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/share/gcc/python" else install -d -m 0755 "$GDB_DIR" \ "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/share/gcc/python" mv "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/libstdc++.so".*-gdb.py \ "$GDB_DIR" mv "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/share/gcc/python/libstdcxx" \ "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/share/gcc/python" fi
install -d -m 0755 "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/$PATH_OFFSET/lib" mv "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/$PATH_OFFSET/lib/"libstdc++*.so.* \ "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/$PATH_OFFSET/lib" || true
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------- PKG_PATH="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/libgcc-dev" # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
install -d -m 0755 "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" mv "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib" \ "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" || true
if [ "$AELTRA_BUILD_FOR" = "cross-tools" ]; then install -d -m 0755 "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/$PATH_OFFSET" mv "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/$PATH_OFFSET/lib" \ "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/$PATH_OFFSET" || true fi
# A cross compiler has no package of these. The libraries of its target are in # the packages of the target. if [ "$AELTRA_BUILD_FOR" = "cross-tools" ]; then for ENTRY in fixincludes gcc-16-plugin-dev libatomic1 libcc1-0 libgcc \ libgomp1 libitm1 libstdc++6; do rm -r "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$ENTRY" done fi
